messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-01-22] standup/atlas/2026-01-22: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-08-01] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Review of INC-2025-017 (the auth gateway, 2025-07-27). The root cause was an expired intermediate certificate. We decided that certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-08-14] standup/boreal/2025-08-14: Changes to auth-gateway need two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-01-29] standup/ember/2025-01-29: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2026-05-18] standup/ember/2026-05-18-2: The Ember team noticed that auth-gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-17] standup/atlas/2025-03-17: If the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down: it relies on it for service tokens.
- [2025-03-31] handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway: Ownership change: the auth gateway now sits with the Boreal team. Team Ember no longer owns it.
- [2025-12-23] handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway: From today the pager for auth-gateway rings the Atlas team, not team Boreal. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-02-11] incident-review/INC-2025-004: Review of INC-2025-004 (the notifier, 2025-02-06). The root cause was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. We decided that notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20-2: The auth gateway is a Ember service.
- [2025-04-28] incident-review/INC-2025-011: INC-2025-011 review. What happened: the ledger service saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26. Why: an index missing after the schema migration. Follow-up decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
- [2025-12-29] standup/ember/2025-12-29-2: Observation from team Ember: after the traffic shift, the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent. The ledger remains a Ember service.
- [2025-10-22] standup/dune/2025-10-22: We agreed today that webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys. The reason is that a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.
- [2026-01-13] standup/atlas/2026-01-13: The Atlas team noticed that Ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-18] standup/atlas/2025-04-18: Per the change policy, Ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2026-05-08] incident-review/INC-2026-009: INC-2026-009 review. What happened: scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. Why: two leaders elected during a network partition. Follow-up decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009.
- [2025-12-16] standup/ember/2025-12-16: The ledger service deploy window (unchanged): on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-12-23] standup/atlas/2025-12-23: The Atlas team noticed that the billing API's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-08] standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2: New dependency for billing-api: feature-flags. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. Boreal noticed that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-20] standup/boreal/2025-02-20: Decided in today's standup: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, since the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-07-28] standup/cinder/2025-07-28: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.

Question: Which note records the decision that auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour, and when was it written?

So the note is standup/atlas/2026-01-22, written 2026-01-22. Answer in one short line.
